tasks.task:
# Target
Task T10 — Discovery attribution and readiness reason. Feature `structured-logging-pin-diagnostics`, spec revision r8-pin-diagnostics-narrow9.

Read first, bounded: `.scratch/structured-logging/spec.md` §4 (AD17), §5 AC10-1..AC10-5, §6 T10; `.scratch/structured-logging/decisions.md` rulings 8, 9; `.scratch/structured-logging/issues/10-discovery-attribution-and-readiness-reason.md`.

# Change
1. `internal/upstream/dedicated.go` (discovery site; if the actual site differs, stop and report BLOCKED-with-evidence): emit `failure_stage` and a bounded `failure_reason` distinguishing auth-during-initialize from tools-list timeout; `http_status` exactly when the failing stage produced one; endpoint sanitized to scheme/host/port/path.
2. `internal/service/refresh.go`: retryable/next-attempt (`error.retryable`, `next_attempt_ms` iff an automatic retry is scheduled); the readiness hook at refresh.go:211 (the success guard of `report(assembly, err)` whose `err` is currently unread).
3. `internal/service/ops.go`: populate the finite `Reason` classes (currently empty).
4. `cmd/mcp-bridge/wiring.go`: `publishObserver` updates readiness on rejection, not only on publish.
5. Tests: `internal/upstream/dedicated_test.go`, `cmd/mcp-bridge/serve_edge_test.go` — AC10-1..5.

# Acceptance (AC10-1..AC10-5)
- AC10-1: a discovery failure names `failure_stage` and a bounded `failure_reason`, distinguishing auth-during-initialize from tools-list timeout; the emitted records carry the AD-pinned levels — `upstream_discovery_failed` at `warn` (AD17) and, per the pass outcome, the accompanying `catalog_refresh_failed` at `warn` with `retained_published` or `error` with `none_available` (AC08-1/AC08-7) — a diagnostic at any other level (in particular `debug`) fails this criterion.
- AC10-2: `http_status` is present exactly when the failing stage produced an HTTP status; timeout failures instead name the timeout class and value in `failure_reason` (per AD17).
- AC10-3: no credential, header, query string or body; `endpoint` reduced to scheme/host/port/path.
- AC10-4: each failure states retry-scheduled vs correction-required (`error.retryable`), with `next_attempt_ms` present iff an automatic retry is scheduled (per AD17).
- AC10-5: after a rejected pass the affected server's readiness `Reason` is non-empty and identifies the failure, distinct from not-yet-probed; this criterion depends on the hook site `internal/service/refresh.go:211` (the success guard of `report(assembly, err)` whose `err` is currently unread; a failed pass falls through to `runtime.Current()`) reached via the T10 `publishObserver` readiness update.

# RED/GREEN
RED first: the discovery-failure test asserts stage/status/endpoint attribution — expected failure. Capture it, then implement to GREEN.

# Verify
`go test ./internal/service ./internal/upstream ./cmd/mcp-bridge -run 'Discovery|Readiness|Refresh'`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l` changed files (empty).

# Receipt
Write `.omp/artifacts/receipt_T10.json` per the receipt schema (task_id T10, status COMPLETED, evidence entries with command and exitCode).

# Constraints
- Only the files in the dispatch effects. No other production files.
- No credentials/headers/query/body in any field; endpoint sanitizer emits scheme/host/port/path only.
- No metric changes; no schema_version increment; no debug-only diagnostics.
- No induced-failure review gate or shared fault-injection harness; per-test doubles named in the RED are permitted (ruling 19).
- At most 42 read/search operations before the first edit; if exceeded, stop and report stalled.
- No external SDK/vendor research.
